# Ouro UI

> Designed down to the last tap and the last prop. Interactions that feel right to the humans using them. Code that's obvious to the agents building with them. Copy-in source distributed as a shadcn/ui registry on GitHub (ourostack/ouro-ui). No npm package: the shadcn CLI copies each component into your app.

## Install

In an existing Vite or Next.js app with Tailwind CSS v4 and an "@/*" path alias, run shadcn init once, with the Base UI base and without -t/--template, then add items:

```sh
npx shadcn@latest init --base base --preset nova --yes --no-monorepo
npx shadcn@latest search 'ourostack/ouro-ui#v0.7.0'      # list the items
npx shadcn@latest view 'ourostack/ouro-ui/dialog#v0.7.0'  # read one item
# Once per app, before the first component: the tokens every component needs.
npx shadcn@latest add ourostack/ouro-ui/ouro-base#v0.7.0
npx shadcn@latest add ourostack/ouro-ui/dialog#v0.7.0     # install a component
```

- Add ouro-base once, before the first component. No component installs it, so no later add changes the app's stylesheet (in v0.7.0 every component still installs it, and an add can rewrite the stylesheet). Without it nothing fails to build: overlays have no backdrop or motion and fields no border, and in development the first component to mount logs the command to run.

- A new Vite app needs @tailwindcss/vite, @import "tailwindcss";, a Vite @ alias, and "paths": { "@/*": ["./src/*"] } in both tsconfig.json and tsconfig.app.json (no baseUrl on TypeScript 6) before init: shadcn reads the root file, and tsc -b builds the app one.
- --preset nova lets init run without prompts. It sets shadcn's starting theme, font and icons, which Ouro components read like any shadcn theme. The install test runs nova and vega; other presets are untested.
- A GitHub source is owner/repo#ref; an item is owner/repo/item#ref. @v0.7.0, github: and /tree/ URLs do not work.
- A release tag (#v0.7.0) installs the item and every Ouro dependency at that tag. Without a ref, items come from main, which is for contributors and can hold unreleased changes; use a release tag or @ouro.
- Components land in components/ouro/<component>/ and the helpers they import in lib/ouro/, one file each. Ouro UI never writes to components/ui/, so do not pass --overwrite on a first install.
- Tests are optional: add <item>-tests beside the item (npx shadcn@latest add ourostack/ouro-ui/dialog#v0.7.0 ourostack/ouro-ui/dialog-tests#v0.7.0), or ouro-tests for all of them. They need Vitest 4.1.11 or later in browser mode, Playwright 1.58.1 or later and Storybook 10.2.10 or later, and never change a version the app already has (v0.7.0's items still carry versions: after add, restore the versions you had pinned). Ouro UI's own CI runs them on Vitest 5 only; Vitest 4 is the stated minimum, not a tested one. The ouro-testing install message lists the config files to add.
- The @ouro namespace serves the newest release (the same code as #v0.7.0): add "registries": { "@ouro": "https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/r/{name}.json" } to components.json, then npx shadcn@latest add @ouro/ouro-base @ouro/dialog (ouro-base once per app).

## Items

- `ouro-base`: Add it once per app, before your first component; no component installs it, so later adds never touch your stylesheet. What every Ouro UI component needs in the app's CSS: success and warning colors, a destructive foreground, the field border color (--input) and --radius when your theme has none, the motion tokens, the press utility, the keyframes for spinners, progress bars and skeletons, and --ouro-layer, the z-index of sheets and dialogs (50; raise it in a :root rule of your own if your app has fixed bars above z-50).
- `ouro-theme`: Ouro UI's own look, as a shadcn theme for :root and .dark. Skip it to keep your app's theme.
- `ouro-lib`: Every helper in lib/ouro in one item. You don't need to add it: each component installs only the helpers it imports (the lib-<name> items).
- `ouro-testing`: Installed with every -tests item; you don't need to add it. The test kit Ouro UI's tests use: Vitest browser projects with the drag, flick, tap, touchDrag, touchStep, pointerPress, emulateMedia, pageZoom, resetPageZoom, setPageZoom and restoreTouch commands, the rotate helper (which turns the phone viewport and resets Chromium's zoom; the ouro-touch project fails a test that leaves the page zoomed), the act helper, the holdFrames helper (which holds animation frames and the clock still so a test steps a spring itself), axeExclude, and the end-to-end story helper.
- `button`: A button, or a link styled as one. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/button.md
- `text`: Body text in the theme's type scale and colors. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/text.md
- `heading`: A section title, `<h1>` to `<h6>`, in the theme's foreground color. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/heading.md
- `sheet`: A panel that slides in from an edge and is dragged back to dismiss: the mobile form of a dialog. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/sheet.md
- `dialog`: A dialog that presents itself for the screen: a centered dialog on wider screens and a bottom sheet you can drag away on phones (below 640px). Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/dialog.md
- `confirm-dialog`: Asks the user to confirm an action, with Cancel focused first. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/confirm-dialog.md
- `field`: A labeled form control: the label, an optional description, the control and its error, wired together with ids that match between the server and the browser. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/field.md
- `fieldset`: A titled group of related fields, such as an address, rendered as a `<fieldset>` named by its legend. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/fieldset.md
- `link`: A text link that navigates through your router. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/link.md
- `text-field`: A labeled one-line text input on the Field contract: pass `label`, and `error` from your server action or client check. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/text-field.md
- `text-area`: A labeled multi-line text field on the Field contract, a native `<textarea>`: pass `label`, and `error` from your server action or client check. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/text-area.md
- `checkbox`: A labeled checkbox on the Field contract, with the label to its right: pass `label`, and `checked` with `onCheckedChange` (or `defaultChecked`). Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/checkbox.md
- `checkbox-group`: A group of checkboxes under one legend, on the Field contract, for picking any number of choices: pass `legend`, and `options` (or `Checkbox` children). Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/checkbox-group.md
- `radio-group`: A group of radios under one legend, on the Field contract, for picking exactly one choice: pass `legend`, and `options` (or `Radio` children). Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/radio-group.md
- `switch`: A labeled on/off switch on the Field contract, with the label to its right: pass `label`, and `checked` with `onCheckedChange` (or `defaultChecked`). Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/switch.md
- `form`: A form that validates with the browser's own constraints (`required`, `type="email"`, `pattern`) and shows server errors on the matching fields. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/form.md
- `edit-sheet`: Edits something in a form inside a dialog: the whole interaction, done right. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/edit-sheet.md
- `select`: A labeled list of choices on the Field contract: pass `label`, `options` (or `SelectItem` children) and `error` from your server action or client check. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/select.md
- `native-select`: A labeled native `<select>` on the Field contract: pass `label`, `options` (or `<option>` children) and `error`. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/native-select.md
- `number-field`: A labeled number input on the Field contract: pass `label`, and `error` from your server action or client check. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/number-field.md
- `slider`: A labeled slider on the Field contract: pass `label`, and a `defaultValue` (or `value` with `onValueChange`). Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/slider.md
- `combobox`: A text input that filters a list of items as people type, on the Field contract: pass `label`, `items`, and `error` from your server action or client check. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/combobox.md
- `toaster`: Shows the toasts you send with `toast("Saved")` from `@/lib/ouro/toast`: render it once, at the root of your app, inside `OuroProvider` if you use one, or alone. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/toaster.md
- `spinner`: A spinning ring that says something is loading. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/spinner.md
- `progress`: A bar that shows how far along a task is, or that it is under way when you can't tell. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/progress.md
- `skeleton`: A shimmering placeholder in the shape of content that is still loading. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/skeleton.md
- `avatar`: A person's picture, or their initials until it loads or when it fails. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/avatar.md
- `badge`: A short label for a status, category or count: "Draft", "Vegan", "3". Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/badge.md
- `alert`: An inline message in the page: something saved, something failed, something to know before going on. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/alert.md
- `separator`: A thin line in the theme's border color between groups of content, horizontal or vertical. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/separator.md
- `kbd`: A keyboard shortcut, in the reader's platform's notation: `keys={["mod", "k"]}` shows ⌘K on a Mac, iPhone or iPad and Ctrl+K elsewhere. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/kbd.md
- `popover`: A small non-modal panel beside its trigger, for a short form or a few choices: a share link, filters, a quick edit. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/popover.md
- `tooltip`: A short label that appears beside its trigger on hover and keyboard focus, for an icon button's purpose or a control's shortcut. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/tooltip.md
- `hover-card`: A preview of where a link goes, shown when a mouse rests on the link or the keyboard focuses it: a cook's profile, a recipe's summary. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/hover-card.md
- `menu`: A list of actions that opens from a button, from a right-click or long press, or from a menubar, with one API for all three. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/menu.md
- `command`: A command palette: a searchable list of every action in the app, in a dialog. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/command.md
- `tabs`: Tabs that switch between panels in place: an accessible tab list with roving focus, arrow-key navigation, a line that slides to the selected tab with the theme spring, and 44px tabs on touch screens. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/tabs.md
- `segmented-control`: An iOS-style segmented control: a row of equal segments with a raised thumb that slides to the checked one, for switching how one view shows its content in place, such as list or grid. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/segmented-control.md
- `accordion`: A stack of titles that each open their own content, for FAQs and long settings pages. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/accordion.md
- `collapsible`: One section that opens and closes under its title, such as nutrition facts under a recipe. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/collapsible.md
- `show-more`: "Show more" for a long list or a long text. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/show-more.md
- `card`: A surface that groups one thing's content: a media slot across the top, a title with a description and an action, a body, and a footer. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/card.md
- `item`: One row of a list: leading media, a title with a description, and trailing actions. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/item.md
- `item-group`: A list of `Item` rows, with an optional label that names it, lines between the rows, and what to show when it is empty. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/item-group.md
- `empty`: What a list, search or page shows when it has nothing in it: an icon, a title that says what is empty, a sentence on what to do, and the action that does it. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/empty.md
- `scroll-area`: A scrolling region with a slim scrollbar that matches the theme, inside a height you set. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/scroll-area.md
- `aspect-ratio`: A frame that keeps an image, video or map at a fixed shape while its width follows the layout, so the page does not jump when the media loads. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/aspect-ratio.md
- `stack`: Lays its children out top to bottom with an even gap. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/stack.md
- `row`: Lays its children out side by side with an even gap, centered up and down. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/row.md
- `navbar`: The bar across the top of an app: your brand, the main links and a few controls, with the current page marked `aria-current="page"`. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/navbar.md
- `sidebar`: The column of links down the side of an app, in sections, with the current page marked `aria-current="page"`. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/sidebar.md
- `sidebar-layout`: The shell of an app with a `Sidebar`: the sidebar beside the page from 640px up, in view while the page scrolls, and a sticky top bar with the sidebar's menu button below 640px. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/sidebar-layout.md
- `stacked-layout`: The shell of an app with a `Navbar`: the bar across the top, in view while the page scrolls, and the page below it in a centered column. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/stacked-layout.md
- `auth-layout`: The page for signing in, signing up or resetting a password: one `Card` in the middle of the screen, with your brand, the title as the page's `<h1>`, the form, and a line under the card. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/auth-layout.md
- `breadcrumb`: The trail from the top of the site to the current page: a labelled `<nav>` with an ordered list of links, the last item marked `aria-current="page"`. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/breadcrumb.md
- `pagination`: Page navigation for a long list: Previous, the page numbers with gaps, and Next, with the current page marked `aria-current="page"`. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/pagination.md
- `navigation-menu`: A row of links where some open a panel of further links, each with a line of description: the navigation of a site with more pages than fit in a bar. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/navigation-menu.md
- `table`: A data table: a caption, column headers, and rows, from `columns` and `rows` or from parts. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/table.md
- `description-list`: One thing's details as pairs of a term and its value: a recipe's prep time and servings, an order's date and total, an account's email. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/description-list.md
- `toggle`: A button that stays pressed until it is pressed again, such as Bold in a text toolbar. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/toggle.md
- `toggle-group`: A row of related toggles that share one value, such as text alignment or bold, italic and underline in a toolbar. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/toggle-group.md
- `button-group`: Related buttons joined into one control, such as Previous, a page number and Next, or a split button. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/button-group.md
- `otp-field`: A one-time code entry on the Field contract: one slot per character, with focus that moves as the person types, a whole code pasted at once, and `autoComplete="one-time-code"` so phones offer the code from a text message. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/otp-field.md
- `file-field`: A labeled file input with a drop zone, on the Field contract. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/file-field.md
- `color-field`: A color on the Field contract: a swatch that opens the system color picker, next to the same color as hex text, kept in step both ways. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/color-field.md
- `swipe-actions`: A list row with actions beside it that a horizontal swipe reveals: swipe toward the start for the `trailing` actions (Delete, Archive), toward the end for the `leading` ones (Pin). Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/swipe-actions.md
- `reorderable`: A list the user puts in order: recipe steps, a queue, favorites. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/reorderable.md
- `calendar`: A month grid to pick a day or a range of days, with the arrow keys or a press. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/calendar.md
- `date-picker`: A labeled date field. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/date-picker.md
- `carousel`: A row of slides the user swipes or steps through with Previous and Next buttons: recipe photos, a few featured cards. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/carousel.md
- `resizable`: Panels side by side (or stacked) with a draggable handle between each pair: a file list beside an editor, a preview above a console. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/resizable.md
- `chart`: A chart drawn in the theme's colors, which people can use without seeing it: a figure named by its `title`, a summary for screen readers, and a table of every value (visible with `showTable`). Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/chart.md
- `message`: One message in a chat: who wrote it, their avatar and what they wrote, with any attachments under it. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/message.md
- `message-list`: A conversation: `Message`s in a scrolling, labeled region that opens at the newest one. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/message-list.md
- `attachment`: A file attached to a chat message, or waiting to be sent with one: its icon, name and size. Docs: https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/attachment.md
- `button-tests`: Optional: the Vitest browser tests, type tests, stories and Playwright spec for button, and the tests of everything button installs, so the installed files reach 100% coverage. Add it beside button: add button button-tests. It names Vitest, Playwright and Storybook without a version, so the CLI installs one only when your app lacks it and never changes a version you have.
- `text-tests`: Optional: the Vitest browser tests, type tests, stories and Playwright spec for text, and the tests of everything text installs, so the installed files reach 100% coverage. Add it beside text: add text text-tests. It names Vitest, Playwright and Storybook without a version, so the CLI installs one only when your app lacks it and never changes a version you have.
- `heading-tests`: Optional: the Vitest browser tests, type tests, stories and Playwright spec for heading, and the tests of everything heading installs, so the installed files reach 100% coverage. Add it beside heading: add heading heading-tests. It names Vitest, Playwright and Storybook without a version, so the CLI installs one only when your app lacks it and never changes a version you have.

Add it beside sheet: add sheet sheet-tests. It names Vitest, Playwright and Storybook without a version, so the CLI installs one only when your app lacks it and never changes a version you have.

- `ouro-tests`: Optional: every Ouro UI component with its tests, type tests, stories and Playwright spec, and the test kit. The whole suite in one command. It names Vitest, Playwright and Storybook without a version, so the CLI installs one only when your app lacks it and never changes a version you have.
- Helpers, one item per file in lib/ouro, each installed with the components that import it (and `<name>-tests` for a helper with tests): `lib-announce`, `lib-appearance-hints`, `lib-class-name-check`, `lib-cn`, `lib-current-path`, `lib-dev`, `lib-env`, `lib-floating`, `lib-key-shortcuts`, `lib-last-input`, `lib-open-mode`, `lib-ouro-provider`, `lib-refs`, `lib-router-link`, `lib-server-element`, `lib-spring`, `lib-stretched-link`, `lib-toast`, `lib-tones`, `lib-touch-target`, `lib-use-backdrop-anchor`, `lib-use-command-shortcut`, `lib-use-dev-messages`, `lib-use-drag`, `lib-use-field`, `lib-use-keyboard-scrollable`, `lib-use-media-query`, `lib-use-ouro`, `lib-use-sheet-presentation`.

## Docs

- [Docs](https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/): one page per component, with props and examples. Each page is also Markdown at https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/<item>.md, the URL each item above ends with.
- [Installing](https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/installing.md): what ouro-base writes, what an add changes in package.json, and the "use client" notice in Vite builds.
- [Testing](https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/testing.md): what the shipped tests need, Vitest 4, and how to find Ouro UI's fields in an app's own tests.
- [Forms](https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/forms.md): which component shows which message, and how each control posts its value.
- [OuroProvider](https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/ouro-provider.md): routing every href through the app's router, with the React Router adapter and the Next.js provider file in full. It installs with every component that renders links and with tooltip; otherwise add lib-ouro-provider by name (v0.7.0 has no such item: there it comes with every component).
- [Parts](https://ourostack.github.io/ouro-ui/docs/parts.md): the building-block parts of Sheet, Dialog and Field, for layouts the props do not cover.
- [README](https://github.com/ourostack/ouro-ui#readme)
